spans.s:
रिङ्ख् रिङ्ख् (connected with rts. रिख्,
रख्, रङ्ख्, रिङ्ग्, रङ्ग्), cl. 1. P.
रिङ्खति, &c., to go, move, creep, crawl (said of
young children); to go slowly; to slip.
रिङ्ख, अस्, m. See under रिङ्खा below.

रिङ्खा, f. creeping, sliding; dancing; one of a
horse's paces; a horse's hoof; deceiving, disappoint-
ing, (according to some also अस्, m. in the previous
senses); the plant Carpopogon Pruriens.

रिङ्खण, अम्, n. the act of crawling, creeping
(said of children who creep on all fours).

रिङ्ग् रिङ्ग् (connected with rts. रङ्ग्,
रिङ्ख्, &c., see above), cl. 1. P. रिङ्गति,
&c., to go, move, creep, crawl (said of young children),
to move slowly or with difficulty; to slip: Caus.
रिङ्गयति, &c., to cause to creep.

रिङ्गण, अम्, n. the act of moving, creeping,
crawling (= रिङ्खण); slipping, sliding; deviating
(from rectitude, &c.).
रिङ्गत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, creeping, crawling, moving.

रिङ्गमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, creeping, crawling,
slipping.
रिङ्गि, इस्, f. going, moving, motion.
रिङ्गित, अम्, n. motion, surging (of waves).

रिङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping, crawling (said of young
children).
